subject.title: [Bug]: ACP config triggers gateway restart loop — acpx fails to load after self-triggered restart

question: Which open PR should be the canonical landing path for the ACP config restart-loop fix tied to this issue?
rationale: This issue is valid and source-reproducible, but overlapping contributor fix PRs mean maintainers should choose the branch and test coverage to land rather than spawning another repair PR.

options.title: Use the reporter's fix PR
options.body: Adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102212 as the canonical fix because it directly closes this issue, is mergeable, and includes production gateway proof plus focused regression tests.

options.title: Consolidate sibling coverage first
options.body: Ask the open PR author to preserve any stronger top-level `acp` object-add coverage from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102209 before merge.

options.title: Pause both PRs
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause both branches if maintainers want a different ACP lifecycle design than hot plugin reload for `acp` config changes.

recommendation.title: Use the reporter's fix PR
recommendation.body: Adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102212 as the canonical fix because it directly closes this issue, is mergeable, and includes production gateway proof plus focused regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history most directly ties vincentkoc to the implicated reload planner and ACP auto-enable paths.
